facts.value: A bachelor’s degree does not need to be completed at the time of application, but at least 80% of the required credits in the bachelor’s program must be completed.
Proof of enrollment in the bachelor’s program and a provisional transcript that includes an average grade and all previous exam performances, issued by an authorized grading institution.

Example 1: Maximum ECTS Bachelor: 180 ECTS, Minimum ECTS for application: 144 ECTS. Example 2: Maximum ECTS Bachelor: 210 ECTS, Minimum ECTS for application: 168 ECTS. Example 3: Maximum ECTS Bachelor: 240 ECTS, Minimum ECTS for application: 192 ECTS.
If the bachelor's degree certificate is not yet available, provisional admission can only be granted under the condition of a successful bachelor’s degree.
The bachelor’s degree certificate must be submitted by the end of the first semester of the master’s program to obtain definitive admission.
An online application via the Uni Assist portal is sufficient even if the bachelor’s degree was completed at a university outside of Germany.
For applications to a higher semester, an application for credit transfer along with a record of performance must be submitted.
Credits not yet listed can be transferred if a transfer application is submitted with the application.
The program has admission restrictions for all semesters.
For the summer semester, applications for the second or fourth semester are possible. For the winter semester, applications for the third semester are possible.
Application by January 15 for classification into the 2nd or 4th semester.
Application by May 15 for classification into the 3rd semester.
Enrolment in a higher semester can only occur if open study places are available and the corresponding number of ECTS credits for transfer is available.
For up to 30 ECTS, classification into the 2nd semester. For 31 to 60 ECTS, classification into the 3rd semester. For 61 to 90 ECTS, classification into the 4th semester.
If more applications are received for the higher semester than open study places are available, a ranking will be created according to the valid selection statute.
